## What would you like to do?

Describe the task or problem, and why it matters in your everyday use.

## Suggested behavior

What should the plugin do? Would this belong in quick controls or Device settings?

## Device and environment

If hardware-specific, include the exact model and generation, firmware version
if known, and Omarchy version.

## Alternatives and related requests

Link any related issue or roadmap item. Screenshots or sketches are welcome.

## Testing

Do you own the relevant hardware and want to help test? This is optional.
